ORDER
THIS MATTER comes before the Public Employee Labor Relations Board at its regularly
scheduled meeting on April 7, 2026, upon a motion to disqualify Matthew Huchmala as the
Hearing Examiner for the above-captioned cases. Having reviewed the record, heard the
arguments of the parties, and being otherwise sufficiently informed, the Board finds no
extrajudicial evidence of bias for the Hearing Examiner and the motion is denied.
